public_gates: probe local first-action overrides on current hidden states
export recovery_anchor.npz if at least row16 recovers
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M278
do not run a new actor update in M278
do not use old checkpoint hidden states
do not loosen row16 terminal-margin floor
hypothesis: A local first-action override evaluated under the current M272 hidden state can recover terminal-margin slack for row16 without cross-checkpoint hidden leakage.
success_criteria: row16 is probed with current M272 observation and hidden
candidate overrides are evaluated by simulator terminal margin
recovery_anchor.npz exports at least one recovered row or the failure is documented
exported NPZ loads through the existing trajectory anchor loader
no PPO or actor update is run
failure_criteria: source checkpoint hidden states are used as current actor input
no action improves row16 and the failure is not documented
PPO or actor update is run

commands.name: m278_probe
commands.command: Implement and run current-hidden local-action recovery probe for fragile terminal-margin rows.

decision_rule: M278 completes only if it either exports a validated current-hidden recovery anchor or proves row16 cannot be locally recovered by the registered action grid. The first actor update using it must be pre-registered separately.
